headline: Apple Music's red icon reportedly swapped for black-and-white design
summary: Apple Music's iconic red app icon has reportedly been replaced with a black-and-white version in the latest iOS 27.2 beta, with the eighth note getting a slightly sharper angle. The new logo was previously spotted on the Apple Music Hall website, and early reaction to the redesign has been largely negative.
